title: Redstone Wand By Erebus
description: A legendary Redstone Tool that opens a portable component shop and features a global existence limit.
body:
# ⚡ Redstone Wand ⚡
The ultimate utility for Redstone engineers.

### 🛠️ Features
* **Mobile Shop:** Right-click to buy pistons, observers, and more using Redstone dust.
* **Global Limit:** Only 3 wands can exist at once! 
* **Era System:** Admins can use `/resetwands` to wipe the world of old tools.
* **Anti-Hoard:** Cannot be stored in Ender Chests.

### 📜 Crafting
* **Top:** Redstone Torch
* **Middle:** Nether Star
* **Bottom:** Stick
